items.title: F5 Patches Critical Vulnerabilities in BIG-IP, NGINX, and Related Products
items.description: F5 released its February 2026 Quarterly Security Notification on February 4, announcing several medium and low-severity CVEs, plus a security exposure affecting BIG-IP, NGINX, and container services. These issues primarily stem from denial-of-service (DoS) risks and configuration weaknesses, potentially disrupting high-traffic environments like web application firewalls (WAF) and Kubernetes…

items.title: Claude Opus 4.6 Finds 500+ High-Severity Flaws Across Major Open-Source Libraries
items.description: Artificial intelligence (AI) company Anthropic revealed that its latest large language model (LLM), Claude Opus 4.6, has found more than 500 previously unknown high-severity security flaws in open-source libraries, including Ghostscript, OpenSC, and CGIF. items.title: Concerns Raised Over CISA’s Silent Ransomware Updates in KEV Catalog
items.description: CISA updated 59 KEV entries in 2025 to specify that the vulnerabilities have been exploited in ransomware attacks. The post Concerns Raised Over CISA’s Silent Ransomware Updates in KEV Catalog appeared first on SecurityWeek.

items.title: Zscaler Acquires Browser Security Firm SquareX
items.description: Zscaler says the acquisition will allow customers to embed lightweight extensions into any browser, providing increased security and eliminating the need for third-party browsers. The post Zscaler Acquires Browser Security Firm SquareX appeared first on SecurityWeek.
